settings.switching: OST loaded once; before every trial the +2 st PCF is loaded on shift trials; on catch trials the expected session loads an all-zero PCF and the observed session clears the PCF with Audapter('pcf', '', 0); reset() before every trial
settings.input: synthetic sustained /ae/-like vowel, F0 200 Hz; shift trials 1.2 s of phonation still going when the trial stops, catch trials 0.8 s
